_comment: Declarative AutoForm layout for the Count Rate Analysis tool: a persistent dock area with the detector channel-definition page, the drag-drop file list + actions, the per-file count-rate plot and the per-channel results table.

sections.title: Count Rate Analysis
sections.description: Count rate per detector for one or many TTTR files.

sections.title: Channel Definition
sections.description: Detector setup, routing channels and gates that define the channels.
Pick or edit the detector setup that defines the reported channels.

sections.title: Files
sections.description: Queued files and the calculate button.
TTTR files queued for the analysis.
Calculate the count rates and save the results.

sections.title: Count Rates
sections.description: Per-detector-channel count rate (kHz) for each loaded file.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: Count rate (kHz) per file and channel.
Table and plot of the count rates.

sections.title: Excitation windows check
sections.description: The setup's PIE windows and detector gates held against the excitation pulses of the analysed files.

The PIE windows and detector gates held against the excitation pulses the analysed files show (the check every PIE analysis runs): a warning when a window or gate misses a pulse, cuts one, mixes two or lies outside the data; a note when only one pulse is seen (donor-only or not PIE). The count rates are not changed by it.
The offer of the detected windows, shown when the setup's windows or gates do not match the data.

buttons.label: Use detected windows
buttons.description: Count with the windows (and gates, in the data's channel width) detected from the analysed file's micro-time decays instead of the setup's; press Calculate again. The saved setup file is not changed.
